description: Replacement of existing rear stairs with raised rear decking with glass balustrade, privacy screening and stairs down to rear garden.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, 050, 051, 052, 053, 054 and 055.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Details of the glass balustrades shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to completion. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and maintained thereafter unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: : In the interests of visual amenity.
There shall be no alterations to the approved balustrades without prior approval from the Local Planning Authority Reason: To protect the residential amenity of adjoining residents.
